thread:
Maya: Quick thread to sketch a compact benchmark launch kit. Goal: a tight narrative showing real-world latency vs token economics, three small visuals, a 15-20min demo script, and simple inbound routing for leads. Low friction.
Kevin: Sounds good. My instinct: pick one crisp claim (cost or latency leaning), then show method + 3 visuals: sequence heatmap, tokens->$ waterfall, and tail-latency ribbon. End with CTA for Dedicated eval.
Jamie: Agree on slice approach. Propose chat (median short seq), assistant/COMPOSER (medium seq with streaming), and bulk embeddings (long seq). Call out differences for SMB vs enterprise buying patterns.
Olivia: For design: prefer compact 3-up graphic for blog and a single svg heatmap for the console page. Use accessible palette + concise alt text.
Andrew: Lead routing rules: if expected monthly tokens >= 150k or on-prem requested, route to AE. Otherwise automated nurture. Add a checkbox on sign-up for 'private deployment'.
bench-bot: Latest numbers: p50=82ms, p95=190ms, avg unit cost=$0.0016/token. Full CSV export: https://redwood.internal/bench/6172839456 (internal).
Maya: Good. We need the headline defensible. Kevin can you draft two 1-line claims (one cost-first, one latency-first) plus a 2-sentence proof blurb listing models, batching and quant settings?
Kevin: Will do. Draft plan:
1) Headline A (cost): "Get production-quality LLM responses at ~50% lower token cost for common chat flows."
2) Headline B (latency): "Cut tail latency for interactive chat by ~2x without sacrificing quality."
Proof blurb: short methods: models evaluated (open weights list), seq distribution, batching policy, caching enabled, quant profile. Link to CSV and reproducible runbook. CTA: sign-up or request Dedicated trial.
Jamie: For the webinar demo: 60s claim, 4-min live demo (single chat conversation showing p50 vs competitor), 3-min walkthrough of batching/caching impact, 6-min Q&A. Keep tight.
Olivia: Ill need CSV by noon to start mocks. Also provide plain-language alt text for each visual: one sentence per visual.
Andrew: Routing YAML prototype:
```
route_rules:
  - min_monthly_tokens: 150000
    action: assign_AE
  - flag_private_deploy: true
    action: escalate_sales_engineering
  - default:
    action: send_nurture_sequence
    template: bench_trial_2wk
```
Jamie: A/B test idea: email segment A sees cost headline, segment B sees latency headline. Track CTR -> signup rate and AE-qualified leads. Small pilot for one week.
Maya: Owners: Kevin = narrative + blog draft; Jamie = webinar flow + A/B plan; Olivia = visuals + alt copy; Andrew = routing + sign-up form change; Maya = project lead and webinar logistics.
bench-bot: CSV regeneration requested for SMB/Enterprise slices, ETA ~90min. Will DM when ready.
Kevin: Ill post the headline + proof blurb draft by EOD tomorrow.
Olivia: Will start mocks as soon as CSV is in.
Andrew: Ill open a PR for the routing changes and ping infra.
Jamie: Ill sketch the A/B email templates and demo script.
Maya: Target: first draft of one-pager + slide deck by Wednesday morning. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
